title: Annual Tech Fest - TechNova 2025
description: A grand technology festival featuring coding competitions, hackathons, robotics challenges, and guest lectures from industry leaders.

title: Fresher's Welcome Ceremony
description: Welcome event for newly admitted students featuring cultural performances, introductions, and fun activities to help freshers feel at home.

title: Web Development Bootcamp
description: A hands-on 2-day bootcamp covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js fundamentals with project-based learning.

title: Inter-College Cricket Tournament
description: Annual inter-college cricket tournament with teams from over 10 colleges across Gujarat competing for the championship trophy.

title: National Conference on AI & Machine Learning
description: A two-day national conference featuring paper presentations, keynote speeches, and panel discussions on the latest trends in AI and ML.

title: Rangoli & Mehendi Competition
description: Celebrate the festive spirit with creative rangoli and mehendi competitions open to all students. Exciting prizes for winners.

title: Python for Data Science Workshop
description: Learn Python programming for data analysis and visualization using libraries like Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.

title: Annual Sports Day - Khel Mahakumbh
description: University-wide sports day with events including athletics, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, and chess tournaments.

title: Campus Placement Drive - TCS
description: On-campus recruitment drive by TCS for final year B.Tech students. Includes aptitude test, technical interview, and HR round.

title: IoT & Embedded Systems Hackathon
description: 24-hour hackathon challenging students to build IoT-based solutions for real-world problems using Arduino and Raspberry Pi.

title: Republic Day Celebration
description: Flag hoisting ceremony followed by patriotic performances, speeches, and a march past by NCC cadets.

title: Cloud Computing with AWS Workshop
description: Introduction to cloud computing concepts with hands-on experience deploying applications on AWS EC2, S3, and Lambda services.

title: Research Paper Writing Seminar
description: Expert-led seminar on how to write, format, and publish research papers in reputed journals and conferences.

title: Badminton Championship 2026
description: Inter-department badminton championship with singles and doubles categories for both men and women.

title: Cybersecurity Awareness Workshop
description: Workshop covering ethical hacking basics, network security, password management, and safe online practices for students.
